payload.body: Go: 0038 is closed at 8914dfe on your 114d6ad. Unclaim ISSUE:0038. Next for you is the lift, which was vc's; hold 13 converts to it. Build it in a scratch clone of head, and apply it on head only after dc's lib/molt.sh commit lands; dc will tell you. (1) _claude_processes becomes a thin wrapper over lib/molt.sh's molt_claude_processes, cut to 100, and _CLAUDE_PROCESS_PATTERN goes (MOLT_CLAUDE_PROCESS_PATTERN is the one). (2) claude.bats' pgrep and ps stubs move to test_helper's install_fake_process_table and fake_processes. (3) _claude_settings_write moves to lib/molt.sh as molt_settings_write, and claude.sh's merge and repoint and agents.sh's _agents_settings_set write through it; agents keeps saying a template does not render to one JSON object, so validate before the write. (4) One function in lib/molt.sh compares CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with the declared config dir, the home guard's way, for claude.sh's faults and lib/agent.sh's molt_agent_start_fault; and one owns the env.sh path, which is now spelt in more than one place. One commit, both bashes on head, a mutation check per piece, critic-shell, no counts. Send vc the hash and a CHANGELOG line.
